aboutBio: I am a third-year B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student at SISTec, Bhopal, focused on building full-stack web applications with the MERN stack and strengthening my core software engineering fundamentals.

Alongside developing full-stack interfaces and REST APIs with React, Node.js, Express, and MongoDB, I actively practice Data Structures and Algorithms in C, Java, and Python to sharpen how I reason about time complexity, state, and system design.
I am also exploring Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning—specifically how modern conversational workflows and intelligent tooling can be integrated cleanly into practical web software.

learningJourney.title: 🎤 Lead Speaker & Instructor: MERN Stack & Cloud Architecture Workshop
learningJourney.desc:
Hands-on Architecture Workshop

Organized and conducted a flagship 2-day technical bootcamp on MERN Stack Engineering and Cloud Deployment at SISTec Bhopal. Mentored 120+ engineering students building scalable REST APIs with Express & Node.js, reactive state with React, and robust schema modeling with MongoDB.

Live Demo & Lab Outcomes

  • Live-coded a full-stack real-time collaboration app with Socket.io on stage.
  • Guided students through Git branching workflows and live cloud deployment on Render and Vercel.
  • Rated 4.9/5 across attendee feedback surveys.
learningJourney.imageAlt: Ayush Prajapati delivering MERN Stack Workshop on stage in front of students
learningJourney.challenge: Deliver production full-stack engineering paradigms to 120+ students within a fast-paced 48-hour hands-on curriculum.
learningJourney.solution: Structured modular micro-lectures paired with real-time live coding labs and automated deployment verifications.
learningJourney.outcome: 120+ functional web apps successfully deployed live to Render and Vercel by student cohorts.
learningJourney.deepdive: Spearheaded curriculum development encompassing authentication security, MongoDB indexing, and reactive front-end architectures.

learningJourney.title: 💼 Software Engineering Intern — Full-Stack Systems
learningJourney.desc:
Role & Responsibilities

Delivered production features, code reviews, and RESTful API integrations across React.js and Node.js microservices.

Key Impact

  • Optimized database queries and API response times by 35%.
  • Engineered modular, reusable UI components with responsive UX and robust error boundaries.
learningJourney.challenge: Legacy endpoints had unindexed query bottlenecks causing high latency under concurrent load.
learningJourney.solution: Restructured MongoDB compound indexes, implemented query caching, and normalized JSON responses.
learningJourney.outcome: Achieved sub-100ms average latency across core public endpoints.
learningJourney.deepdive: Collaborated in an Agile sprint cycle delivering scalable front-end and back-end modules.

learningJourney.title: 🚀 Cloud Architecture & CI/CD Deployment Specialization
learningJourney.desc:
Overview

Architected automated CI/CD deployment pipelines using GitHub Actions, Docker containerization, and cloud deployment workflows on Render, Vercel, and AWS.

Key Outcomes

  • Automated build, test, and container packaging pipelines with zero downtime.
  • Configured reverse-proxy headers, SSL termination, and environment security guards.
learningJourney.imageAlt: Cloud DevOps Architecture and CI/CD pipelines
learningJourney.challenge: Eliminate manual deployment friction and safeguard production releases against regressions.
learningJourney.solution: Engineered multi-stage GitHub Actions workflows with linting, unit testing, and Docker builds.
learningJourney.outcome: 100% automated release pipeline with instant rollbacks on health check failures.
learningJourney.deepdive: Streamlined infrastructure configuration with secure environment isolation and Docker multi-stage builds.

learningJourney.challenge: Master complex full-stack web technologies from fundamentals to production architecture.
learningJourney.solution: Completed comprehensive coursework with real-world capstone projects and code reviews.
learningJourney.outcome: Awarded certified credential in Full-Stack Web Development.
learningJourney.deepdive: Delved into React hooks, state lifting, Redux Toolkit, Express middleware, and MongoDB aggregations.

learningJourney.title: 🧠 Artificial Intelligence & LLM Application Engineering
learningJourney.desc:
Exploration & Implementation

Developing conversational AI integrations and neural architectures using Google Gemini API, OpenAI APIs, and Python. Engineered real-time streaming chat interfaces with token optimizations.

Focus Areas

  • LLM prompt chaining, streaming token parser, and multimodal input handling.
  • Applied machine learning algorithms for predictive analytics and classification.
learningJourney.challenge: Implement low-latency streaming responses with resilient fallbacks for conversational AI.
learningJourney.solution: Integrated Server-Sent Events (SSE) and token-buffering parsers for instant typing effects.
learningJourney.outcome: Production-ready AI chat workspace integrated directly into personal portfolio.
learningJourney.deepdive: Fine-tuning prompt engineering pipelines and experimenting with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
